summary: Iteration 26: verified /api/feed now merges public videos with posts on shared backend, and both web + mobile Home render the new video card variant that deep-links to the fullscreen watch route. All 4 backend pytest cases and all 6 requested UX flows (web + mobile parity) pass. Founder password preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py serialize_video_for_feed: sets `caption` = title so mobile PostCard would happily accept a video item too — the type discriminator is the only thing preventing wrong rendering. Consider dropping the `caption` alias to make the schema unambiguous. Not blocking.

backend/server.py feed(): sort key is the ISO string of created_at — works because all timestamps are timezone-normalized and lexically comparable, but a real datetime sort would be safer if timezones ever diverge.
web Home.jsx VideoCard: `views` field is rendered but Home never invalidates it after the /videos/:id watch view increments it — a soft-refresh on focus would keep counts fresh (minor UX).
test_credentials: Founder semidiepie@gmail.com / Semi123! unchanged. Auto-purged test users test_* created transiently.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 test_* users and 5 test_* videos (public/private/unlisted mix) — all auto-purged on backend restart.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: /api/feed returns list of items with `type` in {post,video}, sorted by created_at DESC, capped at 60. Videos filtered by visibility=='public' AND author not in viewer block-set. Web feed cards use data-testid=feed-video-<id> + feed-video-thumb-<id> (thumb is a <Link to=/videos/<id>>). Mobile uses testID same names but tap opens /video/<id>. Verified no /posts/*/like network call fires from video cards on either surface. Post card like toggle still works. Pull-to-refresh and comments on regular posts untouched.
